root_cause: The paginacontrole workflow contained duplicated appended YAML fragments after its real terminal step, making the workflow syntactically invalid so GitHub failed it before any job could start.
prevention: Workflow source files must contain one canonical document body and may not contain duplicated appended tails.
A regression must assert one workflow name, one terminal Falen doorgeven step, and no known corruption sentinel.
Zero-job workflow failures must be treated as workflow-parse/config corruption before investigating job runtime.
